scope: Manifest structure and raw file-byte SHA-256 checks only; no analysis engine is run and no scientific conclusion is validated.
limitations: The catalog and its split/exposure declarations are not signed or authenticated; coordinated edits to them cannot be detected without an immutable baseline.
source_manifest is an evidence reference only; its split assignments are not inferred or compared.
Unknown source clusters remain unknown. File counts and duplicate hashes do not establish independent samples or biological replication.
duplicate_input_groups contains IDs sharing declared or observed SHA-256 values; a declaration alone is not proof of byte equality.
hash_basis is retained as declared metadata; this checker always hashes raw file bytes and does not reproduce image decoding or transformations.
omission: Per-input paths and third-party material inventory are not included in this public summary.

_public_export.scope: Selected original summary/identity fields only. This export does not rerun tests and does not certify later integrated PR commits.
